description:
Perform a spatial cluster analysis on world cities using the DBSCAN algorithm.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the vector layer '/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_populated_places.shp'.
3. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox) and search for 'DBSCAN clustering'.
4. Run the 'DBSCAN clustering' algorithm on the populated places layer with the following parameters:
   - Minimum cluster size: 3
   - Maximum distance between clustered points (epsilon): 5 (degrees)
5. The algorithm will create a temporary layer with a new field (usually 'CLUSTER_ID') indicating the cluster assignment.
6. Export this result to a new file: Right-click the output layer > Export > Save Features As. Select 'GeoJSON' format. Save it to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/clustered_cities.geojson'. Ensure the output includes the cluster ID field.
